card.name: Words just before 'preservative'
card.fires_on: Small words like 'no', 'any', 'a' or 'common' that come right before the word 'preservative' or 'additive'. Seen in storage text saying a product contains no preservative, or describing a preservative or additive.

modes.label: Contains no preservative
modes.description: The word 'no' or 'any' after 'contains' or 'does not contain', where 'preservative' is expected next.

modes.label: Describing an additive
modes.description: The word 'a' or 'common' in an appositive that names a preservative or additive.
modes.example: idase due to the presence of sodium metabisulfite, a<< common>> additive in anesthetic products containing epine
